| title = 5 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Municipalities''' | [[Compostela, Davao de Oro|Compostela]] | [[Maragusan]] | [[Monkayo]] | [[Montevista, Davao de Oro|Montevista]] | [[New Bataan]] }} | year = 1998 | members_label = Representative | members = [[Maricar Zamora]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Partido Federal ng Pilipinas}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Davao de Oro's 1st congressional district''' is a [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]] for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Davao de Oro]], formerly '''Compostela Valley'''.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} It was created ahead of the [[1998 Philippine House of Representatives elections]] by Republic Act No. 8470 that established the province initially named Compostela Valley.{{cite web |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1998/01/30/republic-act-no-8470/ |title=Republic Act No. 8740 |date=30 January 1998 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021 |archive-date=1 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201041924/http://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1998/01/30/republic-act-no-8470/ |url-status=dead }} The district encompasses most of the area of its namesake valley in the Mindanao Pacific Cordillera which were formerly within [[Davao del Norte's 1st congressional district|Davao del Norte's 1st district]]. It currently comprises the municipalities of [[Compostela, Davao de Oro|Compostela]], [[Maragusan]], [[Monkayo]], [[Montevista, Davao de Oro|Montevista]] and [[New Bataan]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Maricar Zamora]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2019/04/17/republic-act-no-11296-2/ |title=Republic Act No. 11297 |date=17 April 2019 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021}}{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
